description: Fill in or edit the listing: name, description, services, service_area (other cities served), hours, social, phone, website, industry_label. A complete listing can appear in Google, is shown higher in its city and appears in the cities it serves. Needs an API key the confirmed owner approved.

hours.description: Opening hours in schema.org form, e.g. "Mo-Fr 08:00-17:00; Sa 09:00-13:00" (shown as a table and marked up for search); other text is shown as written.

name.description: The business name as customers know it. A spelling fix is saved at once; a name with a phone, web address, promotion or an added city waits for a check by Trusoro.

service_area.description: Other cities served; the listing also shows on those city pages.

social.description: Links to the business pages on Google, Facebook, Instagram, Yelp, Nextdoor and similar sites. Other sites are refused.

name: update_listing
title: Edit a listing
